verses.1: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song. God be merciful to us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us. Selah.
verses.2: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.3: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.4: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.5: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.6: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.7: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), revised as a poetic KJV-tradition translation filtered through the theology of abiding in Christ.
